preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == T + 1 and all(len(s.strip()) >= 1 for s in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: The input consists of T+1 lines where the first line is an integer T (1 <= T <= 10) and the subsequent T lines are non-empty binary strings S containing only '0' and '1' with length N (1 <= N <= 1000).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(counts[i] == len({(s.count('1') % 2, s[0] if s else None, s[-1] if s else None) for s in substrings}) for i, (substrings, counts) in enumerate(zip(all_substrings_list, [int(line) for line in stdout_lines])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the number of distinct equivalence classes of substrings of S, where two binary strings are equivalent if they have the same length and the same parity of '1's, and the same first and last characters (if length > 0), effectively grouping substrings by (parity of 1s, first char, last char).
